text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Tokyo Daishoten has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So many people...
Did everyone come to see the Tokyo Daishoten...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why all of a sudden?
We didn't even advertise or anything."
choice_data_list: Our fans really came through for us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Christmas event,
Smart Falcon poured out her honest feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Touched by her feelings, the fans carried out
grassroots promotional campaigns and more
to make the Tokyo Daishoten the best it had ever been.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, this won't do.
The real thing is just starting,
and I'm already feeling so overwhelmed with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wasn't wrong after all.
I'm so glad I kept on running."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "All our fans are here, giving us so much support."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As an umadol,
there's no greater happiness than this~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: To shine on this ultimate stage.
It's to shine on this ultimate stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're right!
Falco was just being careless☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Falco's happiness belongs on the stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In front of so many people,
I'll win! Sing and dance! And deliver my feelings—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Today, Falco's gonna become—a sparkling,
top Umadol!"
